## hunt / summary
ttp,score,max_score,status,verdict,verdict_level,confidence,coverage_complete,coverage_reason,lead_count,review_priority
hollowing,1,2,DETECTED,LIKELY,likely,medium,True,,2,high

## hunt / finding_details
ttp,check,tag,confidence,inference,rationale,facts,limitations
hollowing,hollowing.mem_private_at_image_base,lead,medium,"The main module's image base is backed by MEM_PRIVATE memory, not a file-mapped MEM_IMAGE region.","A genuine PE image loaded normally is always MEM_IMAGE at its base — MEM_PRIVATE there means nothing was actually mapped from the executable file this process is supposed to be running. Structural on its own, but a manually-mapped, otherwise benign loader (some DRM/anti-cheat/packer stubs) can also produce this without hollowing — correlated with a second anomaly below before it counts toward the score.",VA=0x140000000 type=MEM_PRIVATE protect=PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE,A manual-mapping loader that isn't hollowing can also produce this signal alone.
hollowing,hollowing.rwx_at_image_base,lead,low,The main module's image base carries RWX-family protection.,"RWX at the image base is needed to write replacement code during hollowing, but RWX alone is routinely used by JITs, debuggers, and some legitimate packers — a lead, not proof, on its own.",VA=0x140000000 protect=PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE,Does not by itself distinguish hollowing from JIT/legitimate self-modifying-code use cases at this address.
hollowing,hollowing.structural_correlation,detection,medium,"2 independent structural signal(s) correlate at the same image base: MEM_PRIVATE at image base, RWX protection.","Any one of these signals alone has a plausible benign explanation (manual mapping, a capture-time read race, a JIT/packer using RWX). MEM_PRIVATE at the image base correlated with a missing/wiped MZ header AND/OR RWX protection at that same address is materially harder to explain away — the combination the module's own checks were designed to catch.",VA=0x140000000 MEM_PRIVATE at image base + RWX protection,Structural correlation is strong evidence but not a substitute for live-execution corroboration (no thread-context signal is available for this hunter).
